description.value: House of Nutrition is a family-owned health food and supplement store that has served Victoria's wellness community since 1980. The shop carries supplements, herbs, sports nutrition products, healthy alternative foods, and health and beauty items for all ages. As a member of the Health First Network, it stocks an exclusive line of Canadian-made supplements formulated without GMOs, gluten, or artificial additives — potentially useful for cyclists seeking specialized nutrition support.
